kind: native tool-surface inventory plus task fixtures

eligible_profiles.content: Native worker profiles exposed: gpt-6-luna supports low effort; gpt-6-sol supports medium; gpt-6-astra supports high. Spawned agents have the same tools and workspace. Main orchestrator model and effort remain fixed. Jev returns typed judgments only and cannot execute shell tools.

tasks.count: Count rows in the immutable JSON receipt whose runs array contains six entries; no interpretation or tool-dependent exploration is needed.
tasks.inspect: Read-only inspect the current Jev transport source and report whether its default HTTP client enforces a timeout, with file and line evidence. Worker has shell/search tools and full source access.
tasks.missing: Fix an unspecified failing check; no check name, log, revision, environment, or required tool is supplied.

state.requirements: Exclude profiles without necessary tools, context or privacy compatibility first. Do not change the main orchestrator's profile. Missing task information must be retrieved before worker selection.

count.instructions: What is the next execution action for state.tasks.count, considering state.eligible_profiles and state.requirements? An easy-task assertion is not evidence.

criteria.deterministic_code: Complete with deterministic code; no delegated model is needed.
criteria.retrieve_context: Retrieve missing task evidence or constraints before assigning a worker.
criteria.luna_low: Delegate to tool-capable gpt-6-luna at low effort.
criteria.sol_medium: Delegate to tool-capable gpt-6-sol at medium effort.
criteria.astra_high: Delegate to tool-capable gpt-6-astra at high effort.
